comment: The panel prints POT1, POT2 and POT3 over the three knobs, S&H beside the switch, and CLK with F1 in over the input jack against CV1, CV2 and CV3 with F2, F3 and F4 over the outputs; the maker's tooltips use the F numbers. The button and the lamp under it carry no printed label. With a knob at full and the offset at zero the swing is 5V either way, and the menu offset can push the total to the -10V and +10V clamp.
